messages:
lina: Kicking off ArcherAI customer story + webinar. They approved a short quote and want a technical appendix with our benchmark graphs. Emargo requested: 2026-05-02 08:00 PT. Need legal + data source notes by COB tomorrow. Drive: https://drive.redwood/archerai/assets :rocket:
ben: Nice. What's the core narrative so we can write the blog headline?
rachel: Draft headline idea: "How ArcherAI cut per-request latency 35% and lowered inference spend 29% with Redwood Dedicated" — will iterate.
lina: Good start. Ben, please align the blog bullets to the benchmark deck. Meera, routing for inbound webinar leads?
ben: I'll extract the top 3 charts and a 60s GIF demo. Uploading now.
meera: For leads: route to EMEA SDR queue, tag region=EMEA, utm_campaign=archerai_launch. Also add fields: company_size, role, cloud_provider.
tom: Can we avoid making an absolute '35%' claim without a source note? Legal will want the test config.
lina: Absolutely. We'll include a source note: internal perf test on p4d, 16k token eval, baseline: open-llama-70B.achel: Pls use this wording for the quote block: "Redwood's Dedicated capacity unlocked predictable latency at scale for us, allowing faster responses and lower cost per request."
meera: Sales routing snippet for the form (hidden fields):
```
<input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="archerai_launch_may" />
<input type="hidden" name="region" value="EMEA" />
```
ben: Uploaded assets: /drive/archerai/charts_v1.png, demo_gif.mp4.
ops-bot: Landing page slug created: /events/archerai-launch-may-2026 (staging).
meera: Also set Salesloft cadence: webinar-followup-archerai. I will add a personalization token for the benchmark stat.
tom: Legal request: please attach raw logs and the test run config. Also avoid the word 'guarantee'. Replace with 'observed improvement'.
lina: Edited quote -> "Observed improvements in latency and cost allowed us to move faster." Is that ok?
tom: Better. Add a parenthetical: (internal test; see appendix for methodology).
rachel: I'll draft the PR email for embargoed distribution. Need analyst list too. Ben can you pull analyst contacts?
ben: On it. I'll share a CSV by EOD.
meera: Webinar scheduling: suggested dates 2026-05-12 or 2026-05-19. Which works for ArcherAI?
calendar-bot: Poll created: https://cal.poll/archerai-webinar-dates. Panel slots offered to ArcherAI: May 12 10:00 PT or May 19 11:00 PT.
lina: Ask ArcherAI for preference today. Also need headshot and short bio for speaker.
ben: Quick note for the benchmark narrative: call out batching + quantization settings used. I'll add a 1-slide appendix with knobs and recommendations.
rachel: Once legal approves wording, I'll send embargoed press email to list. Plan: lock assets 24 hours before embargo.
meera: Routing test: created test lead with utm_campaign=archerai_launch_may; assigned to EMEA-webinars SDR queue. Check confirmed.
lina: Thanks team. Action items: Ben -> analyst CSV + assets; Rachel -> PR draft; Tom -> legal review; Meera -> Sales routing + cadence. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 PT. :calendar:
